day_shape: 64 items: CENTCOM confirms US naval blockade with 68 vessels redirected and Iran crude loadings down to one-seventh of pre-war levels, Jerusalem Post reports 774 US military casualties, UK/Canada/Australia joint statement on WCK investigation closure, heavy regime-channel messaging on defence self-sufficiency.

threads.label: US blockade and Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: CENTCOM said more than 20 warships are supporting the blockade against Iran, with 68 commercial vessels redirected, 3 disabled and 2 boarded as of 21 August. NATO's top commander convened a videoconference on freedom of navigation in the Strait, and a US-sanctioned Iranian tanker Sibu 1 was reportedly seized by Somali pirates off Yemen.

threads.label: Iran oil exports and economic strain
threads.summary: Iran International reported crude loadings have fallen to about one-seventh of pre-war levels under the US blockade, with Chinese receipts also down sharply. Parliament speaker Ghalibaf warned Iran cannot endure if people go hungry, drawing hardline backlash, and called for plans to overcome sanctions after new US measures.

threads.label: US-Iran diplomacy and casualties
threads.summary: Trump told reporters Iran "would love" a deal but not the right one, saying the US has complete control over the Strait of Hormuz. The Jerusalem Post reported US military wounded or killed in the Iran war rose to 774 per Pentagon figures, while Israeli security sources said chances of near-term escalation had decreased.

threads.label: World Central Kitchen investigation closure
threads.summary: The UK Foreign Office issued a joint statement with Australia and Canada on Israel closing the investigation into the April 2024 strike on the World Central Kitchen convoy in Gaza. Poland summoned Israel's ambassador over the killing of aid worker Damian Sobol, and Defa Press reported the UK-Canada-Australia statement.

threads.label: IDF operations in Gaza and south Lebanon
threads.summary: The IDF reported shooting a Palestinian who crossed the Yellow Line in southern Gaza, capturing a knife-armed Hamas operative in central Gaza, and striking a building in Baraashit, south Lebanon after suspects entered it. The military also announced the killing of Hamas platoon commander Sobhi Sami Mahmoud Shahtot in a Wednesday strike in Nuseirat.

threads.label: Regime defence and self-sufficiency messaging
threads.summary: On Defence Industry Day, Defa Press carried messages claiming Iran's missile and drone production continues and that weapons output has doubled in the past year, with commanders Radan and Talai Nick cited. Khamenei's office posted material from the fortieth commemoration of the "Martyr Leader" at the Razavi shrine.

threads.label: Iran domestic rights and dissent
threads.summary: Iran International reported the Supreme Court upheld the death sentence of 24-year-old political prisoner Arghavan Fallahi for "baghi," and published a letter from transgender prisoner Ghazal Marzban alleging rape in Intelligence Ministry detention. A 19-year-old British man pleaded guilty to an April arson attack on Iran International's London offices.

events.summary: On January 21, 2025, President Trump issued Executive Order 14173, "Ending Illegal Discrimination and Restoring Merit-Based Opportunity," which revoked Executive Order 11246. Accordingly, the U.S. Department of Labor publishes this final rule to rescind the implementing regulations for Executive Order 11246.
